# FMC Media PC 0.2.3

- One-time passcode activation on first launch; saved across updates and sign-out.
- Settings → About → Check for updates, plus notification of newer Windows releases at startup.
- Download & install verifies file size and SHA-256 before opening the installer.
- Fasel mirror recovery from the public homepage, with retries and verified-origin persistence.
- Windows has a separate update channel; Android TV 1.0.10 remains the legacy latest APK release.

Download FMC-Media-PC-0.2.3-setup.exe. Supports Windows 10/11 x64; bundled mpv and source runtime need no separate Python/Node installation.
